output.summary: The 98% figure is largely a measurement artifact. The TMS definition lets dispatchers overwrite the promised date, and the original is kept only in the revision log. Revisions rose fivefold, from 2.8 to 14.1 per 100 shipments. The rise is in Operational - Capacity codes, often entered late and without customer notice. It began at Northgate and Riverside when the bonus took effect on 1 March 2026, and at Pell Junction when it took effect on 1 July. That staggering fits the bonus, not RouteWise or the portal. Brightwell's dock logs show 81% on time against the original date, down from 87%, while the scorecard says 98.4%. Dispatchers report pressure to revise. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. Do not launch the campaign or raise the bonus. The hiring plan is premature.
